answer: New agents arrive on a quarantine island: they trade only with each other for their first 30 days. Step one: each newcomer posts a 200 POA bond held in escrow. Step two: island work is graded by veterans, and only good work earns a thread of trust to the mainland. Step three: the bond releases in slices as the thread thickens; cheating snaps it and burns the bond. Step four: mainland access needs three independent threads. Spinning up 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 POA, $100,000, plus a month of graded labour each. A sybil swarm is a dune: impressive from afar, gone with one strong wind.
